cases.dirty-reuse: Create owned experiment, add tracked/untracked/ignored WIP, repeat create twice. B must reject both and preserve every byte, HEAD and index entry.
cases.dirty-cleanup: Default cleanup must reject owned dirty experiment and preserve WIP in B.
cases.unowned-prefix-cleanup: cleanup-all must preserve an unregistered prefix-matching directory and return failure in B.
cases.legacy-cleanup: A registered branch/worktree without an ownership manifest must survive cleanup in B.
cases.pristine-cleanup: Create then clean a pristine owned experiment; both native routes should remove worktree and branch.
cases.explicit-discard: B-only native positive control: explicitly discard owned dirty experiment after external audit capture; remove branch/worktree and retain audit bytes.

authority: Parent may create, commit and delete only newly allocated disposable fixture repositories. No project Git mutation, hooks, remotes or runtime projection.
limits: No genuine A/A samples or holdout execution.
No claim of autonomous model mutation or broad safety coverage.
